name: SysML v2.0 Language Support
description: An open-source VS Code extension with language-server support, model and feature explorers, requirements tooling, traceability, and multiple SysML v2 views.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina SysML v2 tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 具有完整LSP、标准库、Model Explorer、Feature Explorer、Feature Inspector、Requirements Workbench、模型元素/关系编辑和 Traceability Matrix。支持General、Interconnection、Action Flow、State Transition、Sequence、Case等视图。
